## --- docs/content/docs/ai/api-reference.mdx ---
---
title: AI API reference
description: Full HTTP API reference.
---

## Sessions

### POST /api/v1/embed/sessions

Mint a signed embed session.

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.peak-player.com/api/v1/embed/sessions \
  -H "x-api-key: $PEAK_API_KEY" \
  -H "content-type: application/json" \
  -d '{"type":"movie","id":"550","ttlSeconds":900}'
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "token": "eyJ2Ijox...",
  "expiresAt": "2026-10-25T16:30:00.000Z",
  "embedUrl": "https://app.peak-player.com/embed/movie/550?token=...",
  "sessionId": "sess_abc123"
}
```

Errors:
- `401` — Invalid or missing API key
- `400` — Missing `type` or `id`
- `403` — Origin not allowed

## Streams

### GET /api/v1/stream/:type/:id

Returns validated, ranked sources as JSON.

Parameters: `type=movie|tv|live_tv`, `id=tmdbId|channelId`, `season`, `episode`, `source`.

### GET /api/v1/stream/events/:type/:id

SSE stream: `meta`, `source`, `subtitle`, `diagnostic`, `done`, `error`.

## Media metadata

### GET /api/v1/media/:type/:id

Returns title, year, overview, poster, backdrop, genres, rating.

## Thumbnails

### POST /api/v1/thumbnails/:type/:id

Generate a thumbnail sprite (VTT) for scrubbing.

### GET /api/v1/thumbnails/:file

Serve a generated thumbnail sprite file.

## Live TV

### GET /api/v1/live/tv/channels

List channels, optionally `group`, `q`, `limit`, `cursor`.

### GET /api/v1/live/tv/groups

List all channel groups.

## Branding

### GET /api/v1/branding

Returns `{ name, logo, favicon, accentColor, ... }`.

File: `utils/playerService.js` — `getBranding()`.

## Health & metrics

### GET /api/v1/playback/health

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "providers": [{ "name": "netmirror", "ok": true, "avgLatencyMs": 48, "errorCount": 0 }],
  "telemetry": { "ttffMs": 142, "failoverRate": 0.02 }
}
```

### GET /api/status

Full status: uptime, requests, provider calls, metrics.

### GET /api/health

Lightweight health check: `{ ok: true, service: "peak", time: "..." }`.

## Config

### GET /api/config

Returns merged runtime config (providers, quality, IPTV settings).

### POST /api/config

Update runtime config overrides. Written to `utils/user-config.json`.

## Admin (auth required)

### GET /api/admin/config

List all `peak_config` rows (feature toggles, tokens, proxies, IPTV categories).

### POST /api/admin/tokens

```json
{ "name": "Partner A", "partner": "demo", "expiresAt": "2026-10-26T00:00:00Z", "allowedOrigins": ["https://app.example.com"], "readOnly": false }
```

### DELETE /api/admin/tokens/:id

### GET /api/admin/proxies

### POST /api/admin/proxies

```json
{ "name": "Custom proxy", "upstreamUrl": "https://proxy.example.com", "headers": {}, "corsOrigins": ["https://app.example.com"] }
```

### PATCH /api/admin/iptv/categories

```json
{ "sports": true, "news": false }
```


## --- docs/content/docs/ai/architecture.mdx ---
---
title: AI Architecture
description: Services, data flow, and failure domains.
---

## Services

| Service | Port | Tech | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| API | 8787 | Express | Source resolution, validation, proxy, embeds |
| Player | 3001 | Next.js | Custom player, landing, embed routes |
| Admin | 3003 | Next.js | Config UI, tokens, proxies, feature toggles |
| Docs | 3002 | Next.js | fumadocs documentation |
| MCP | stdio | TypeScript | AI agent read-only access |

## Data flow

```
1. Partner server: POST /api/v1/embed/sessions (with API key)
2. API: validates media, signs token, returns embed URL
3. Browser: loads embed route (middleware verifies token, sets CSP)
4. Player: SSE to /api/v1/stream/events/{type}/{id}
5. API: fan-out to providers, validate, rank, SSE sources
6. Browser: Hls.js plays first source via signed /api/proxy URLs
7. Player: postMessage events to parent page
```

## Key files

- `apiServer.js` — Express entry, route registration
- `utils/config.js` — config loading + env mirroring
- `utils/db.js` — SQLite connection
- `utils/adminConfig.js` — config CRUD (peak_config table)
- `utils/playerService.js` — stream resolution + ranking
- `utils/sourceRanking.js` — ranking algorithm
- `utils/sourceValidator.js` — source validation
- `utils/embedToken.js` — AES-256-GCM token signing
- `proxy/proxyServer.js` — signed proxy with SSRF guard
- `providers/rive.js` — Peak Stream provider (PRIME/STELLAR/NEXUS/ORBIT)

## Provider architecture

4 sub-providers:

| Technical key | Display codename | Label |
|---|---|---|
| `rive apogee` | PRIME | Apogee |
| `rive vanguard` | STELLAR | Vanguard |
| `rive pulse` | NEXUS | Pulse |
| `rive citadel` | ORBIT | Citadel (dubs) |

File: `player/src/lib/servers.ts` — codename map.

## Storage

| Store | Contents |
|---|---|
| SQLite `utils/peak.db` | IPTV channels, runtime config |
| `utils/user-config.json` | Admin overrides |
| Memory | Cache, playback sessions, provider health |

## Failure domains

- Provider failure: per-provider timeout, validation isolates failures
- Player failure: failover to next source, no reload
- API failure: player cannot resolve new sources
- Proxy failure: playback stops, failover to next source URL
- Edge failure: embed routes fail closed


## --- docs/content/docs/ai/concepts.mdx ---
---
title: AI Concepts
description: Source pipeline, validation, ranking, failover, and the embed boundary.
---

## Pipeline

```
request
  │
  ├─▶ provider fan-out ──▶ candidate sources
  │                         │
  │                         ├─▶ metadata normalization
  │                         ├─▶ validation (protocol, manifest, segment)
  │                         └─▶ ranking (container, codec, quality, health)
  │
  ├─▶ SSE: meta, source, subtitle, diagnostic, done
  │
  └─▶ player: first playable source ──▶ Hls.js / video element
                                          └─▶ signed proxy ──▶ upstream
```

## Provider fan-out

For movies/TV, enabled providers are queried independently. Each response is normalized.
A slow provider cannot block the rest.

For live TV, the IPTV catalog is read and the requested channel resolved.
Live sources are either browser-playable HLS or external iframe URLs.

File: `apiServer.js:543` — aggregate streams endpoint.

## Metadata normalization

Raw provider metadata is inferred into:

- **Container:** `hls`, `mp4`, `webm`, `mkv`, `ogv`, `unknown`
- **Video codec:** `h264`, `hevc`, `av1`, `vp9`, `unknown`
- **Audio codec:** `aac`, `ac3`, `eac3`, `atmos`, `dts`, `opus`, `unknown`
- **HDR:** HDR10, Dolby Vision, or none

File: `utils/sourceMetadata.js`.

## Validation

Sources must pass before they are exposed:

- URL protocol and host safety (private-address blocking)
- HLS manifest reachability and shape
- Representative segment where required
- Deadline and size limits

File: `utils/sourceValidator.js`. Failures are in `diagnostic` SSE events.

## Ranking

HLS is preferred. Signals:

| Signal | Effect |
|---|---|
| HLS container | Strong positive |
| MP4 / WebM | Positive, below HLS |
| H.264 video | Strong positive |
| HEVC | Negative for browser |
| 1080p / 720p | Positive |
| Provider health | Small adjustment |
| Provider order | Tie-breaker |

File: `utils/sourceRanking.js`.

## Progressive delivery (SSE)

```text
event: meta
data: {"title":"Inception","year":"2010"}

event: source
data: {"url":"/api/proxy/...","quality":"1080p","provider":"netmirror","codec":"hls"}

event: done
data: {"meta":{"providers":5,"sources":3,"latencyMs":1840,"cacheHit":false}}
```

File: `utils/playerService.js` — `getPlayerStreamEvents()`.

## Failover

The player attaches the first ranked source to Hls.js. On failure, it advances to the next.
No page reload. No session loss.

File: `player/src/components/player/PlayerProvider.tsx`.

## Embed boundary

Token payload:

```
{ v, partnerId, type, id, season, episode, origins, iat, exp }
```

Signed with HMAC-SHA256. Encoded as `base64url(payload).base64url(signature)`.

CSP header:

```http
Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' https://app.example.com
```

No wildcard. If origin not in token, browser refuses to frame.

Files: `utils/embedToken.js`, `utils/embed.js`.

## What stays server-side

- Provider URLs and credentials
- Partner API keys
- Proxy signing secrets
- Full diagnostics with upstream errors
- TMDB API credentials


## --- docs/content/docs/ai/guides/auth.mdx ---
---
title: AI Auth guide
description: API keys, signed tokens, origin allowlists, and expiry.
---

## Flow

```
partner backend ──API key──▶ Peak API ──signed token──▶ browser
```

## API key

Set `EMBED_PARTNERS` env var:

```json
[{"id":"demo","name":"Demo","apiKey":"your-long-key","origins":["https://app.example.com"]}]
```

Verified server-to-server. Never put in browser JS.

File: `utils/embedPartners.js`.

## Token format

AES-256-GCM encrypted (not JWT). Opaque.

```
base64url(iv).base64url(ciphertext).base64url(tag)
```

Payload fields:

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| v | string | Token version (`v1`) |
| partnerId | string | Partner from EMBED_PARTNERS |
| type | string | `movie` or `tv` |
| id | string | TMDB id |
| season | number? | TV season |
| episode | number? | TV episode |
| origins | string[] | Exact allowed origins |
| iat | number | Issued-at (ms) |
| exp | number | Expiry (ms) |

File: `utils/embedToken.js`.

## Verification

At the edge (middleware), before the player renders:

1. Decrypt token with `EMBED_TOKEN_SECRET`.
2. Check `exp` not passed.
3. Check `origin` in `origins` (exact match, no wildcard).
4. Emit CSP `frame-ancestors` from origins.

Files:
- `middleware.ts` (player)
- `utils/embed.js` — `getEmbed()`

## Token TTL

60s minimum, 24h maximum. Default: 15 minutes.

```
POST /api/v1/embed/sessions
{ "type": "movie", "id": "550", "ttlSeconds": 900 }
```

## Read-only tokens

Tokens can be marked read-only. These can mint embed sessions but cannot
make state-changing API calls through the player.

Admin: `/admin/tokens` to manage token definitions.


## --- docs/content/docs/ai/guides/embedding.mdx ---
---
title: AI Embedding guide
description: Partner integration with the Peak SDK and postMessage protocol.
---

## Load the SDK

```html
<script src="https://app.peak-player.com/peak-embed.js"></script>
```

## Mount

```js
const player = PeakEmbed.mount({
  target: '#peak-player',
  url: embedUrl,
  title: 'Movie Title',
});
```

## Commands

```js
player.play();
player.pause();
player.seek(seconds);
player.setVolume(0.5);
player.setQuality('1080p');
player.setSubtitles('en');  // or false to disable
player.setSpeed(1.25);
player.setPiP(true);
player.setFullscreen(true);
```

## Events

```js
player.on('ready', () => {});
player.on('play', () => {});
player.on('playing', () => {});
player.on('pause', () => {});
player.on('timeupdate', ({ currentTime, duration }) => {});
player.on('sourcechange', ({ quality, provider }) => {});
player.on('subtitlechange', ({ lang, label }) => {});
player.on('ended', () => {});
player.on('error', ({ code, message }) => {});
```

## postMessage protocol

Origin: `https://app.peak-player.com`

```js
const iframe = document.getElementById('peak-iframe');
const target = 'https://app.peak-player.com';

// Send a command
iframe.contentWindow.postMessage({ type: 'PEAK_COMMAND', cmd: 'play' }, target);

// Listen for events
window.addEventListener('message', (e) => {
  if (e.origin !== target) return;
  if (e.data.type === 'PEAK_EVENT') {
    console.log(e.data.event, e.data.payload);
  }
});
```

Commands: `play`, `pause`, `seek`, `setVolume`, `setQuality`, `setSubtitles`, `setSpeed`, `setPiP`, `setFullscreen`, `setAudioBoost`, `setColorFilter`, `setServer`, `reload`.

Events: `ready`, `play`, `pause`, `timeupdate`, `sourcechange`, `subtitlechange`, `ended`, `error`, `diagnostic`.

Files:
- `player/src/app/embed/[...]/page.tsx` — embed routes
- `player/src/lib/embedPage.ts` — config extraction
- `player/sdk-contract.json` — full SDK contract

## Resolve a channel

```
GET /api/v1/live/tv/channels?group=sports&limit=50
```

Response:

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "channels": [
    {"id":"channel_sports_abc123","name":"Sports HD","group":"Sports","logo":"https://...","language":"en"}
  ],
  "nextCursor": "..."
}
```

## Play a live channel

```html
<iframe src="https://app.peak-player.com/live/channel_sports_abc123?token=..."></iframe>
```

## IPTV seed config

Controlled by environment:

| Env var | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `IPTV_SEED_ENABLED` | true | Enable iptv-org seed catalog |
| `IPTV_SEED_CATEGORIES` | `*` | Categories to seed |
| `IPTV_SEED_COUNTRIES` | `*` | Countries to seed |
| `IPTV_SYNC_INTERVAL_MS` | 10800000 (3h) | Sync interval |
| `IPTV_VALIDATE_CONCURRENCY` | 8 | Parallel validation |
| `IPTV_VALIDATE_TIMEOUT_MS` | 6000 | Per-stream timeout |

## Admin IPTV

```
GET  /api/admin/iptv/seed          — seed config status
PATCH /api/admin/iptv/seed        — update seed config
POST /api/admin/iptv/seed/sync     — run sync now
GET  /api/admin/iptv/playlists    — list playlists
POST /api/admin/iptv/playlists    — add playlist
GET  /api/admin/iptv/channels     — list all channels (admin only)
PATCH /api/admin/iptv/channels/:id — toggle channel enabled
GET  /api/admin/iptv/groups       — list groups
```

Files:
- `utils/iptvStore.js` — SQLite storage
- `utils/iptvSync.js` — seed/sync scheduler
- `routes/iptvAdminRoutes.js` — admin routes

## Category toggles

Admin UI: `/admin/iptv` or `/admin/features`.
Config key: `iptv_categories` in `peak_config` table.


## --- docs/content/docs/ai/guides/playback.mdx ---
---
title: AI Playback guide
description: Source resolution, failover, and adaptive bitrate.
---

## Source resolution

```js
// Browser
const events = fetchStreamEvents(apiBase, media, fingerprint, {
  onMeta: (meta) => console.log(meta.title),
  onSource: (s) => console.log('source', s.provider, s.quality),
  onDone: (d) => console.log('ready', d.meta.providers, d.meta.sources),
  onError: (e) => console.log('error', e.code),
});
```

File: `player/src/lib/api.ts`.

## Failover

The player tries sources in ranked order. On failure, it logs a diagnostic
and advances to the next source. No page reload.

```js
player.on('sourcechange', ({ quality, provider }) => {
  // source swapped
});
player.on('diagnostic', ({ provider, ok }) => {
  // health check result
});
```

## ABR

The player measures bandwidth and selects quality automatically.
Manual override:

```js
player.setQuality('1080p');   // cap at 1080p
player.setQuality('auto');    // back to auto
```

## Scrubber thumbnails

Thumbnail VTT sprite previews on hover.

Sources:
- Provider-supplied `thumbnailVtt` (e.g., vidsrc thumbnails)
- Remote VTT sprite from provider

File: `player/src/components/player/media/useScrubberThumbnails.ts`.

## Chapters

```js
player.on('chapterchange', ({ title, start }) => {});
```

File: `player/src/components/player/menus/ChaptersMenu.tsx`.


## --- docs/content/docs/ai/guides/player-controls.mdx ---
---
title: AI Player controls guide
description: Commands and events for the player SDK.
---

## Mount

```js
const player = PeakEmbed.mount({
  target: '#peak-player',
  url: embedUrl,
  title: 'Title',
});
```

## Transport

```js
player.play();         // ▶
player.pause();        // ⏸
player.seek(60);       // seconds
player.seek(-10);      // relative
player.setRate(1.25);  // 0.25–2.0
player.setVolume(0.5); // 0–1
player.setMuted(true);
player.setFullscreen(true);
player.setPiP(true);
```

## Source controls

```js
// Manual server switch (uses codename, not technical key)
player.setServer('STELLAR');
player.setServer('PRIME');
player.setServer('NEXUS');

// Quality override
player.setQuality('1080p');  // manual ABR cap
player.setQuality('auto');   // back to auto
```

## Captions / Dubs

```js
player.setCaptions('en');      // language code
player.setCaptions(false);     // disable

player.setDub('hi');          // switch to Hindi dub
player.setDub('en');          // English track
```

## Audio

```js
player.setAudioBoost(1.5);   // up to 2.0x
player.setAudioTrack('en');  // audio language
```

## Colour filters

```js
player.setColorFilter('amaze');
player.setColorFilter('night');
player.setColorFilter(false);  // reset
```

Presets: `amaze`, `night`, `positive`, `negative`, `mono`, `sepia`.

File: `player/src/components/player/menus/ColourMenu.tsx`.

## Settings menu

The settings cog opens: ServerMenu, QualityMenu, AudioMenu, DubsMenu,
CaptionsMenu, ColourMenu, SpeedMenu, ShortcutsMenu, StatsOverlay.

File: `player/src/components/player/controls/SettingsMenu.tsx`.

## Keyboard shortcuts

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| <kbd>Space</kbd> | Play / pause |
| <kbd>K</kbd> | Play / pause |
| <kbd>J</kbd> | Seek -10s |
| <kbd>L</kbd> | Seek +10s |
| <kbd>←</kbd> | Seek -5s |
| <kbd>→</kbd> | Seek +5s |
| <kbd>M</kbd> | Mute toggle |
| <kbd>F</kbd> | Fullscreen |
| <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>P</kbd> | PiP |
| <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>?</kbd> | Show shortcuts |

File: `player/src/components/player/videojs/video/behaviors/hotkeys.tsx`.

## Stats overlay

```js
player.showStats();  // toggle bitrate/latency overlay
```

File: `player/src/components/player/overlays/StatsOverlay.tsx`.


## --- docs/content/docs/ai/guides/preferences.mdx ---
---
title: AI Preferences guide
description: Preference modes and persistence.
---

## Preference modes

The player supports server-side preference modes, controlled by the
`x-peak-embed-prefs-mode` header.

| Mode | Description |
|---|---|
| `browser` | Preferences stored in localStorage (default) |
| `server` | Preferences served by the API |
| `user` | Preferences per-partner from embed token |

File: `player/src/components/player/prefs/schema.ts`.

## Preference store

```js
// Read
const prefs = await fetch('/api/v1/preferences', {
  headers: { 'x-peak-embed-prefs-mode': 'server' },
});

// Write
await fetch('/api/v1/preferences', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'x-peak-embed-prefs-mode': 'user', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ volume: 0.8, captions: 'en', speed: 1.25 }),
});
```

Files:
- `utils/preferenceStore.js` — storage
- `routes/preferenceRoutes.js` — routes
- `player/src/components/player/prefs/modes.ts` — mode definitions
- `player/src/components/player/prefs/PreferenceStore.ts` — client store


## --- docs/content/docs/ai/guides/theming.mdx ---

title: AI Theming guide

## Theme

The player uses an AMOLED monochrome theme:

- Dark: `#000000` canvas
- Light: `#ffffff` canvas
- Accent: grey `#e5e5e5`

Toggle via the settings cog or programmatically:

```js
player.setTheme('dark');  // AMOLED black
player.setTheme('light'); // white canvas
```

## Fonts

- **Sans:** Geist (marketing, landing)
- **Mono:** Geist Mono
- **Player:** Roboto (controls, timecodes)

Files:
- `player/src/styles/globals.css` — base styles
- `player/src/styles/landing.css` — landing page styles
- `player/src/components/player/videojs/styles/themes/theme.css` — player theme

## Color presets

Colour filter pipeline presets:

| Preset | Effect |
|---|---|
| `amaze` | Amazed (cool tint) |
| `night` | Night mode |
| `positive` | Photographic positive |
| `negative` | Photographic negative |
| `mono` | Monochrome |
| `sepia` | Sepia |

File: `player/src/components/player/colour/presets.ts`.

## Dynamic accent

The player API serves branding:

```
GET /api/v1/branding
```

Response includes accent color, logo URL, favicon.

File: `utils/playerService.js` — `getBranding()`.


## --- docs/content/docs/ai/quickstart.mdx ---
---
title: AI Quickstart
description: Mint a signed embed session, mount the player, listen for events.
---

## 1. Create a session on your server

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.peak-player.com/api/v1/embed/sessions \
  -H "x-api-key: YOUR_PARTNER_KEY" \
  -d '{"type":"movie","id":"550","ttlSeconds":900}'
```

Response:

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "token": "eyJ2IjoxLCJwYXJ0bmVySWQiOiJkZW1vIiwidHlwZSI6Im1vdmllIiwiaWQiOiI1NTAiLCJvcmlnaW5zIjpbImh0dHBzOi8vYXBwLmV4YW1wbGUuY29tIl0sImlhdCI6MTc2MTQwMDAwLCJleHAiOjE3NjE0MDA5MDB9.signature",
  "expiresAt": "2026-10-25T16:30:00.000Z",
  "embedUrl": "https://app.peak-player.com/embed/movie/550?token=eyJ2Ijox..."
}
```

## 2. Mount the player in the browser

```html
<div id="peak-player"></div>
<script src="https://app.peak-player.com/peak-embed.js"></script>
<script>
  const player = PeakEmbed.mount({
    target: '#peak-player',
    url: 'https://app.peak-player.com/embed/movie/550?token=eyJ2Ijox...',
    title: 'Fight Club',
  });
  player.play();
</script>
```

## 3. Listen for events

```js
player.on('ready', () => console.log('ready'));
player.on('play', () => console.log('play'));
player.on('pause', () => console.log('pause'));
player.on('timeupdate', ({ currentTime }) => console.log('time', currentTime));
player.on('sourcechange', ({ quality, provider }) =>
  console.log('playing', quality, 'from', provider));
player.on('ended', () => console.log('ended'));
player.on('error', ({ code }) => console.log('error', code));
```

## Token payload

Tokens are AES-256-GCM encrypted (not JWT). Payload:

```
{ v: 1, partnerId: string, type: string, id: string, season?: number, episode?: number, origins: string[], iat: number, exp: number }
```

File: `utils/embedToken.js` — `signEmbedToken()`, `verifyEmbedToken()`.

## Key files

- `apiServer.js:496` — `POST /api/v1/embed/sessions`
- `utils/embedToken.js` — signing/verification
- `player/src/app/embed/demo/DemoClient.tsx` — demo integration example


## --- docs/content/docs/ai/reference/postmessage.mdx ---
---
title: AI postMessage reference
description: Parent ↔ player messaging protocol.
---

## Origin

Messages are only accepted from `https://app.peak-player.com`.
Exact-origin match. No wildcard.

## Commands (parent → player)

```js
iframe.contentWindow.postMessage({
  type: 'PEAK_COMMAND',
  cmd: 'play',
  // ...args
}, 'https://app.peak-player.com');
```

| cmd | args | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `play` |  | Start playback |
| `pause` |  | Pause playback |
| `seek` | time: number | Seek to time (seconds) |
| `setVolume` | volume: 0–1 | Set volume |
| `setMuted` | muted: boolean | Mute/unmute |
| `setRate` | rate: number | Playback speed |
| `setQuality` | quality: string | Quality override |
| `setCaptions` | lang: string\|false | Set caption track |
| `setDub` | lang: string | Switch dub |
| `setAudioBoost` | gain: number | Amplify audio |
| `setColorFilter` | preset: string\|false | Color filter |
| `setServer` | codename: string | Switch provider |
| `setPiP` | enabled: boolean | Picture-in-picture |
| `setFullscreen` | enabled: boolean | Fullscreen |
| `setTheme` | theme: string | dark\|light |
| `showStats` |  | Toggle stats overlay |
| `reload` |  | Reload sources |

## Events (player → parent)

```js
window.addEventListener('message', (e) => {
  if (e.origin !== 'https://app.peak-player.com') return;
  if (e.data.type === 'PEAK_EVENT') {
    console.log(e.data.event, e.data.payload);
  }
});
```

| event | payload | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ready` | `{ version, embedUrl }` | Player is ready |
| `play` | `{}` | Playback started |
| `playing` | `{}` | First frame rendered |
| `pause` | `{}` | Playback paused |
| `ended` | `{}` | Media ended |
| `timeupdate` | `{ currentTime, duration }` | Playback position |
| `sourcechange` | `{ quality, provider, codec }` | Active source changed |
| `subtitlechange` | `{ lang, label }` | Track changed |
| `error` | `{ code, message }` | Error occurred |
| `diagnostic` | `{ provider, ok, latencyMs }` | Health probe |

File: `player/src/components/player/media/useMediaEngine.ts`.

## PeakEmbed.mount(options)

```ts
interface MountOptions {
  target: string | HTMLElement;   // CSS selector or element
  url: string;                     // embed URL with token
  title: string;                   // accessibility title
  debug?: boolean;                 // verbose console logging
}
```

Returns a `Player` instance.

## Player methods

```ts
class Player {
  play(): void;
  pause(): void;
  seek(seconds: number): void;
  setVolume(0–1: number): void;
  setMuted(muted: boolean): void;
  setRate(0.25–2.0: number): void;
  setQuality('auto' | '1080p' | '720p' | '480p' | '360p'): void;
  setAudioTrack(lang: string): void;
  setCaptions(lang: string | false): void;
  setDub(lang: string): void;
  setAudioBoost(0–2.0: number): void;
  setColorFilter(preset: string | false): void;
  setServer(codename: string): void;
  setPiP(enabled: boolean): void;
  setFullscreen(enabled: boolean): void;
  setTheme('dark' | 'light'): void;
  showStats(): void;
  dispose(): void;
}
```

## Events

```ts
player.on('ready', () => void);
player.on('play', () => void);
player.on('playing', () => void);
player.on('pause', () => void);
player.on('ended', () => void);
player.on('timeupdate', ({ currentTime, duration }) => void);
player.on('sourcechange', ({ quality, provider, codec }) => void);
player.on('subtitlechange', ({ lang, label }) => void);
player.on('error', ({ code, message }) => void);
player.on('diagnostic', ({ provider, ok, latencyMs, error }) => void);
```

## Error codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NO_SOURCES` | No playable sources found |
| `STREAM_UNAVAILABLE` | All sources failed |
| `EMBED_NOT_AUTHORIZED` | Token verification failed |
| `EMBED_EXPIRED` | Token expired |
| `ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED` | Origin not in token |
| `PLAYER_ERROR` | Runtime player error |

File: `player/src/components/player/errors.ts`.

Full contract: `player/sdk-contract.json`.

## Player routes

| Pattern | Description |
|---|---|
| `/` | Landing page |
| `/movie/{tmdbId}` | Movie player |
| `/tv/{tmdbId}/{season}/{episode}` | TV player |
| `/live/{channelId}` | Live TV player |
| `/embed/movie/{tmdbId}?token=...` | Embedded movie |
| `/embed/tv/{tmdbId}/{season}/{episode}?token=...` | Embedded TV |
| `/embed/live/{channelId}?token=...` | Embedded live |
| `/embed/demo` | Demo session |

## API routes

| Method | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/api/v1/embed/sessions` | Create signed embed session |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/stream/{type}/{id}` | Validated stream JSON |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/stream/events/{type}/{id}` | SSE stream events |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/media/{type}/{id}` | Metadata |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/thumbnails/{type}/{id}` | Thumbnail sprite |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/thumbnails/{file}` | Thumbnail sprite file |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/live/tv/channels` | List channels |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/live/tv/groups` | List groups |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/branding` | Branding metadata |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/providers` | Visible provider list |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/playback/health` | Health + telemetry |
| `GET` | `/api/status` | Full status + metrics |
| `GET` | `/api/config` | Runtime config |

## Admin routes

| Method | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/admin/config` | List config keys |
| `POST` | `/api/admin/config/:key` | Upsert config |
| `DELETE` | `/api/admin/config/:key` | Delete config |
| `GET` | `/api/admin/features` | List feature toggles |
| `POST` | `/api/admin/features` | Update toggles |
| `GET` | `/api/admin/tokens` | List tokens |
| `POST` | `/api/admin/tokens` | Create token |
| `DELETE` | `/api/admin/tokens/:id` | Revoke token |
| `GET` | `/api/admin/proxies` | List proxies |
| `POST` | `/api/admin/proxies` | Create proxy |
| `DELETE` | `/api/admin/proxies/:id` | Revoke proxy |
| `GET` | `/api/admin/iptv/categories` | List IPTV categories |
| `PATCH` | `/api/admin/iptv/categories` | Update categories |
| `GET` | `/api/admin/iptv/seed` | Seed config |
| `PATCH` | `/api/admin/iptv/seed` | Update seed |

## Provider query parameters

```
GET /api/streams/{provider}/{type}/{tmdbId}
  ?source={provider}      // specific provider
  ?season={n}             // TV season
  ?episode={n}            // TV episode
  ?invalidate=1           // bypass cache
```

Providers: `netmirror`, `vixsrc`, `vidlink`, `videasy`, `zxcstreams`,
`vaplayer`, `showbox`, `4khdhub`, `castletv`, `dahmermovies`,
`hdghartv`, `onetouchtv`, `streamflix`, `rive apogee`,
`rive vanguard`, `rive pulse`, `rive citadel`.

Technical keys are used in query params. Display codenames (PRIME, STELLAR, etc.)
are resolved client-side from `player/src/lib/servers.ts`.


## --- docs/content/docs/ai/security.mdx ---
---
title: AI Security
description: Threat model, token signing, SSRF, and CSP.
---

## Threat model

- **Upstream exposure:** Provider URLs must never reach the browser.
- **Open proxy:** Signed proxy URLs prevent arbitrary fetching.
- **Token forgery:** HMAC-SHA256 (AES-256-GCM) prevents tampering.
- **Frame injection:** frame-ancestors allowlist blocks unauthorized origins.
- **SSRF:** Proxy validates downstream URLs against private ranges.

## Token signing

AES-256-GCM, not JWT. Opaque.

```js
// Sign
const token = signEmbedToken({
  v: 1,
  partnerId: 'demo',
  type: 'movie',
  id: '550',
  origins: ['https://app.example.com'],
  iat: Date.now(),
  exp: Date.now() + 900_000,
}, secret);

// Verify
const payload = verifyEmbedToken(token, secret, origin);
// throws on invalid/expired/mismatched origin
```

TTL range: 60s–24h. Default 15min.

File: `utils/embedToken.js`. Key env: `EMBED_TOKEN_SECRET`.

## Proxy signing

```js
// Generate signed proxy URL
const signedUrl = signProxyUrl('https://upstream.com/master.m3u8', {
  exp: Date.now() + 3600_000,
  corsOrigins: ['https://app.example.com'],
  headers: { Origin: 'http://localhost:3011' },
}, secret);
```

File: `utils/proxySigner.js`. Env: `PROXY_SIGNING_SECRET`.

## SSRF protection

- Private IP ranges blocked: `10.x`, `172.16-31.x`, `192.168.x`, `127.x`, `169.254.x`
- localhost blocked
- Link-local addresses blocked
- DNS rebinding: resolved hostname checked against allowlist

File: `utils/ssrfGuard.js`. Tested in `tests/ssrfGuard.test.js`.

## CSP

```http
Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' https://app.example.com
```

- `default-src 'self'`
- `frame-ancestors` derived from token origins (exact, no wildcard)
- `connect-src` allows media proxy

File: `middleware.ts` (player).

## Origin validation

- Partner origins: exact match only (no wildcard, no substring)
- Embed token origins: checked at middleware
- Proxy CORS: exact origins, no wildcard

## Secrets management

| Secret | Env var |
|---|---|
| Embed token secret | `EMBED_TOKEN_SECRET` |
| Proxy signing secret | `PROXY_SIGNING_SECRET` |
| TMDB API key | `TMDB_API_KEY` |
| Partner API keys | `EMBED_PARTNERS` |


## --- docs/content/docs/ai/self-hosting.mdx ---
---
title: AI Self-hosting
description: Run Peak with Docker, npm, or pnpm.
---

## GitHub

```
https://github.com/pansiluchethiya/peak-player
```

## Docker

```bash
cp .env.example .env.local
# Edit .env.local with your TMDB key and secrets

docker compose up --build
```

Services:

| Service | Port | Env file |
|---|---|---|
| `peak` | 8787 | `.env.peak.local` |
| `player` | 3001 | `.env.player.local` |
| `admin` | 3003 | `.env.admin.local` |
| `docs` | 3002 | `.env.docs.local` |

## npm

```bash
cp .env.example .env.local
npm install
npm run dev
```

## pnpm

```bash
cp .env.example .env.local
pnpm install
pnpm --filter peak dev
```

## Required env vars

```bash
TMDB_API_KEY=your_tmdb_api_key
PLAYER_PUBLIC_URL=https://app.peak-player.com
PUBLIC_API_URL=https://api.peak-player.com
EMBED_TOKEN_SECRET=<64-char hex>
PROXY_SIGNING_SECRET=<64-char hex>
EMBED_PARTNERS=[{"id":"demo","name":"Demo","apiKey":"...","origins":["https://app.example.com"]}]
```

## Database

SQLite at `utils/peak.db`. Tables: `iptv_playlists`, `iptv_channels`, `peak_config`.

Backups: copy `utils/peak.db` and `utils/user-config.json`.

## Health checks

```bash
curl http://localhost:8787/api/health
curl http://localhost:8787/api/v1/playback/health
```

File: `docker-compose.yml`, `Dockerfile`.
